features.name: url_length
features.description: Total length of the complete URL string

features.name: domain_length
features.description: Length of the extracted hostname excluding port and userinfo

features.name: path_length
features.description: Length of the URL path component

features.name: query_length
features.description: Length of the query string following '?'

features.name: num_subdomains
features.description: Number of dot separators in the parsed hostname

features.name: has_ip_address
features.description: Binary flag (1 if hostname is a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address, 0 otherwise)

features.name: has_https
features.description: Binary flag (1 if scheme is https, 0 otherwise)

features.name: has_suspicious_tld
features.description: Binary flag (1 if TLD matches known abusive TLDs: tk, ml, ga, cf, gq, xyz, top, click, pw)

features.name: num_special_chars
features.description: Count of characters in '-_@!%' across the URL

features.name: num_digits_in_domain
features.description: Count of numeric digits in the parsed hostname

features.name: has_brand_keyword
features.description: V2 Brand Spoofing Indicator: 1 if a configured brand keyword appears in hostname on an UNAUTHORIZED registrable domain; 0 if on official brand domain or no brand found

features.name: brand_in_subdomain
features.description: V2 Subdomain Spoofing Indicator: 1 if brand keyword is placed in subdomain of an UNAUTHORIZED registrable domain; 0 if official domain or no brand in subdomain

features.name: has_redirect
features.description: Binary flag (1 if 'redirect' or 'url=' appears in URL, 0 otherwise)

features.name: path_depth
features.description: Number of forward slashes ('/') in the path component
